title: 1 John Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 John 5: faith that overcomes the world, the three who testify, the testimony about the Son, and keeping yourselves from idols.

questions.text: Who has been born of God, according to the first verse?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:1 says that whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God.

answers.text: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ
Whoever keeps all the feasts
Whoever teaches the law to others
Whoever has seen the Son with his eyes

questions.text: What does the letter say about his commandments?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:3 says that loving God means keeping his commandments, and that his commandments are not grievous.

answers.text: They are hidden from us
They are not grievous
They are too many to count
They are only for the elders

questions.text: What is the victory that has overcome the world, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:4 says that whatever is born of God overcomes the world, and that this victory is your faith.

answers.text: Your works
Your wisdom
Your faith
Your patience

questions.text: By what does the letter say Jesus Christ came?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:6 says that Jesus Christ came by water and blood, not with the water only, but with the water and the blood.

answers.text: By fire and wind
By the water only
By bread and wine
By water and blood

questions.text: Which three are named as those who testify?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:7-8 says there are three who testify: the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and that the three agree as one.

answers.text: The Spirit, the water, and the blood
The law, the prophets, and the psalms
The angel, the elder, and the apostle
The sun, the moon, and the stars

questions.text: What is the testimony that God has given, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:11 says the testimony is that God gave us eternal life, and that this life is in his Son.

answers.text: That God will give us a new land to live in
That God has hidden his Son from the world
That God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son
That God judges the whole world by fire

questions.text: What boldness do we have toward him, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:14 says this is the boldness we have toward him: that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

answers.text: That we may see him face to face even now
That we may judge the nations with him
That we need not keep his commandments at all
That if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us

questions.text: What should someone do who sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:16 says he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death.

answers.text: Put him out of the assembly
Ask, and God will give him life
Say nothing at all about it
Bring him before the elders

questions.text: What does the letter say about the whole world?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:19 says that we are of God, and that the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

answers.text: It lies in the power of the evil one
It has already been made new
It knows God and listens to him
It will remain forever

questions.text: What is the last thing the letter tells the little children to do?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:21 closes by telling the little children to keep themselves from idols.

answers.text: Greet one another warmly
Write down what you have seen
Wait quietly in Jerusalem
Keep yourselves from idols
